t: You're looking at The Gardens, an architectural structure in Camden. It was designed by Samuel Sanders Teulon, an English Gothic Revival architect who lived from 1812 to 1873. Teulon is noted for his use of polychrome brickwork, meaning bricks of several colours worked into patterns, and for the complex planning of his buildings. If you look closely at the brickwork, that is the kind of detail he was known for.
